fixture: Ephemeral localhost under /gurbani-learning-library/; nonpersistent browser contexts and synthetic learning only.

Dohra remains before 53; Salok 54 is retained without an invented Mahalla 10 heading
The last Salok retains 57 and 1 and ends before Mundavani; passage boundary controls work
A fresh direct link opens Salok 29 without dropping either source line
Invalid passage numbers leave a fresh reader at a valid first Salok
All 57 Jump destinations select their exact first line at 320px

All 57 Jump destinations select their exact first line at 390px

A bookmarked second line stays exact through three consecutive reloads
A reflection without a bookmark is listed and its actual text can be reopened
Export includes the unbookmarked reflection and current learning
Every existing reader and retained-learning sentinel survives navigation and edits
A real exported file restores notes and bookmarks into a fresh context
Reimport is idempotent and conflicting reflections are retained once
Another bani’s backup is refused without changing either reader’s bytes
Malformed, unknown-edition and out-of-collection backups are rejected atomically
Damaged saved learning preserves its original bytes and remains exportable

Changed source is blocked even after its local hash is renewed: dohra-with-renewed-hash

Gurbani remains fully readable when teaching is unavailable: missing-teaching
The actual root worker verifies and caches all declared assets, including the new reader
Offline reload retains all 117 source occurrences, 114 meanings and 57 studies
Offline passage navigation and a fresh deep link work through the real cache
Offline reflection export works and private notes never enter static caches
There are no uncaught browser runtime errors

limitations: This is desktop Chromium, including narrow viewport emulation; it is not a physical iPhone, Safari, Home Screen or VoiceOver check.
Offline checks use Chromium network emulation and the actual repository root service worker.
Source agreement and UI checks are not qualified Gurbani, Punjabi, Santhiya or interpretation review.
The source-tamper checks renew the changed occurrence hash but intentionally leave the separately pinned source-pack digest unchanged.
Saved-note navigation is checked by opening the selected line through Reading tools; no direct note preview is claimed.
